_readme: Milestone 3 eval set. 'gold.sections' lists the SEC item(s) that legitimately contain the answer (matched on the item code before the colon, e.g. 'Item 7'). Retrieval scores a hit@k if any top-k chunk matches gold ticker + one gold section (+ period when specified). Negatives have gold=null and are reported separately. Gold sections are labeled from 10-K/10-Q structure, NOT from what the system returns, to avoid the 'eval written to match the system' failure mode.
